title: Privacy-Preserving Text Inference for Health-Misinformation Classification and Semantic Retrieval
description: We design a privacy-preserving text inference framework based on CKKS homomorphic encryption for health-misinformation classification and semantic retrieval. The hybrid classifier achieved an accuracy of 0.971 and a macro-F1 score of 0.950, with identical reported metrics under plaintext and ciphertext-based inference.

example_outputs.title: Default inputs
example_outputs.summary: All 1,080 encrypted predictions matched plaintext. Accuracy 0.944, macro-F1 0.896 on CoAID; SIMD packing made encrypted retrieval 26 times faster. A small static embedder replaces BioBERT and MPNet. ISCC-SCT fingerprints and late-fusion retrieval are not reproduced.
